notes: West 8th Street runs along the plate top; its north edge is cut by the plate edge, so the y of its crossings is the middle between the plate top (about 146-175) and the south block line (about 220-240). Fairbanks Avenue: only 'AVENUE' is printed on the upper part and 'FAIRBANKS' on the part south of Bassett; taken as one street. Elberon Avenue: 'AVENUE' printed near the top, 'ELBERON' near y 3900-4200; taken as one street. Nonpareil Street: 'STREET' printed between Bassett and Pica, 'NONPAREIL' south of Pica; taken as one street. Crestline Street: 'STREET' printed on the diagonal south of Bassett, 'CRESTLINE' near Moulton; taken as one street, suffix uncertain (only 'STREET' printed). Steiner Street: the 40 ft street leaving Fairbanks straight south at y about 4720 is labelled only 'ST.' here; it continues south-west off the strip and becomes the street printed 'STEINER' near x 8420. The two '?' streets are stubs running east from Elberon Avenue off the plate edge: one at y 1108 (label cut, begins 'P', probably a Place), one at y 3697 (label cut, begins 'C'). Elberon Avenue continues north of West 8th Street as a stub to the plate top. The 'CITY OF CINCINNATI' strip at y about 4250 between Crestline and Elberon is a parcel, not a street. Pipe and sewer lines inside streets ignored.
